reader.requirement: When a RECORD IS VARYING clause names DEPENDING ON data-name-1, the program places the record length in data-name-1 before each WRITE, REWRITE and RELEASE, so the compiler must take each such statement's record size from the content of data-name-1 at the time the statement executes (GR10 a) and must not overwrite it there (GR9).

edition-consulted.switches: rangeFailsStatement = DialectLevel < 2002: at 1985 a RELEASE outside the SD range is unsuccessful (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10, Amendment 2); from 2002 it raises EC-SORT-MERGE-RELEASE. The length itself is read from data-name-1 on both arms

reader.edition-search: Grepped SequentialIoEmitter.cs, SortEmitter.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs and SortBinder.cs for DialectLevel/DialectBehavior; VaryingLengthArg and the REWRITE length read no edition; the only edition read on the GR8 statements is the RELEASE out-of-range arm.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the length is the content of data-name-1 at every edition; only what an out-of-range RELEASE does (GR10, not this rule) differs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f18_03 covers WRITE, REWRITE and RELEASE taking their size from data-name-1; not covered: zero and the largest value of the item, a COMP data-name-1, and the File Section refusal of data-name-1 (probes dn2, dn3)

probes.expected: FROM 1 TO 10 DEPENDING ON L (PIC 9(4) COMP): L=0 and L=9999 are outside 1..10, 44; L=3 and 10 written at those sizes; L unchanged by each WRITE/REWRITE (GR9); REWRITE of the 3-record with L=3 succeeds, of the 10-record with L=9 is 44 (§1985:VII.1.3.5 d 2); RELEASE at LS=8 and 2 returns those sizes

probes.printed: error COBOL2922: ... the RECORD clause's DEPENDING ON 'L' is described in the file section; data-name-1 shall describe an elementary unsigned integer in the working-storage or linkage section (ANSI §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR4)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR8  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10

reader.notes: GR8 is an obligation on the program; the compiler side is reading data-name-1 at each output statement, which VaryingLengthArg renders as a live read of the item for WRITE and REWRITE (sequential and keyed emitters) and SortEmitter.EmitRelease renders for RELEASE. Probe dn2 shows the content at execution governs and is not altered.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-121/src/dnr1.cob (dnr1-001) at --std 85, FROM 1 TO 12 DEPENDING ON L over an ODO record R (RN PIC 9 + RT OCCURS 1 TO 11) and R2 X(12): WRITE R with RN=3 (ODO size 4) and L=7 wrote 7 positions (read back L=07 3QQQQQQ): data-name-1, not the ODO, sizes the record (GR10 a); WRITE R2 FROM SRC with L=5 wrote ABCDE (L=05); L unchanged by each WRITE (GR9). Data-name-1 in the LINKAGE SECTION of a called program (SR4 allows it): OPEN EXTEND, WRITE G1 with LK=4 wrote SUBR, LK unchanged. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10a; OK §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR4. No edition arm on the size read; the reader's RELEASE arm (DialectLevel<2002) governs only the out-of-range outcome, GR10's last paragraph.
